working_worldgroup_install.artifact: WGSERV.rar (user supplied working Worldgroup + MajorMUD install)

native_contract.zero_semantics: valid setting; only same-level attacks satisfy abs(level difference) <= 0
native_contract.persistence_evidence: Default and working installs use the byte-identical WCCMMUD.DLL while WCCMMUD.MSG/MCV retain different LVLDIFF values (100 versus 10), proving site configuration without binary replacement.
native_contract.fiend_exception: A lower-level FIEND does not receive the LVLDIFF level-range protection when targeted by a higher-level player.
native_contract.protected_room_semantics: An over-range attack is treated as though the players were in a protected room.

runtime_change: Classic PvP now defaults to enabled with LVLDIFF=100 instead of a Reforged-only disabled default.
LVLDIFF=-1 is the sole Classic disable sentinel; 0 is no longer treated as unrestricted.
The working store keeps its compatibility Enabled field synchronized with the native LVLDIFF sentinel and migrates older Reforged disabled records to -1.
Lower-level FIEND defenders are not protected by the level-range gate.
The Classic live path no longer re-applies Reforged generic same-party/guild/level-range policy after the native admission gate.
megamud_compatibility: MegaMUD continues to use ordinary attack commands and receives server-authoritative PvP admission/results; no private range protocol is introduced.
borin_compatibility: Borin treats the server PvP admission and authoritative character state as final and must not impose a private level-range rule.
still_open: native.pvp-policy remains STRONG for Lawful record encoding/admission order, exact safe-zone encoding, any native party/gang restriction, kill/death/corpse ordering, guard/bounty reactions, and exact PvP messages/branch order.
